title: Astronauts Stay Busy on International Space Station Awaiting Flight Home
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Two American astronauts awaiting their return flight from the International Space Station (ISS) have stayed busy carrying out a series of scientific experiments.
sentences.zh: 两名等待从国际空间站返回的美国宇航员忙于进行一系列科学实验。

sentences.en: The U.S. space agency NASA has said the pair – Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams – will remain at the ISS until late March or early April.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局(NASA)说,这对船 — — Butch Wilmore和Suni Williams — — 将在国际空间站停留到3月底或4月初。

sentences.en: When they arrived at the orbiting laboratory in June 2024, the astronauts expected to stay in space for just one week.
sentences.zh: 当宇航员于2024年6月抵达轨道实验室时,他们预计只在空间停留一周。

sentences.en: Their trip was a test flight of Boeing’s Starliner spacecraft.
sentences.zh: 他们的旅行是波音星际飞船的试飞。

sentences.en: While Starliner safely transported the two to the ISS, the spacecraft had several problems that persuaded NASA to send it back to Earth for further testing without the astronauts onboard.
sentences.zh: 当Starliner将这两艘航天器安全运到国际空间站时,该航天器遇到了若干问题,促使美国航天局将这两艘航天器送回地球,以便在宇航员不登船的情况下进行进一步测试。

sentences.en: NASA’s current plan calls for Wilmore and Williams to fly back on a SpaceX spacecraft in late March at the earliest.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局目前的计划要求Wilmore和Williams尽早在三月底飞回SpaceX航天器上。

sentences.en: NASA has been using SpaceX’s Crew Dragon to regularly carry astronauts and supplies to the ISS since 2020.
sentences.zh: 自2020年以来,美国航天局一直利用SpaceX的 " SpaceX " 号乘员龙定期向国际空间站运送宇航员和补给品。

sentences.en: The astronauts have been using their extended mission to carry out experiments.
sentences.zh: 宇航员们一直在利用延长的任务来进行实验。

sentences.en: In addition, Williams stepped out of the space station earlier this month to complete a spacewalk.
sentences.zh: 此外,威廉斯本月早些时候走出空间站,完成了一个空间行走。

sentences.en: Another NASA astronaut, Nick Hague, joined Williams on the spacewalk on January 16, the agency said in a statement.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局的另一位宇航员Nick 海牙于1月16日加入威廉姆斯的太空行走,该机构在一份声明中说。

sentences.en: The two repaired a piece of equipment that helps guide the movements of the ISS.
sentences.zh: 两人修复了一台设备,帮助引导国际空间站的移动。

sentences.en: The spacewalk also included work on an X-ray telescope, as well as maintenance activities for other ISS systems.
sentences.zh: 空间行走还包括一台X射线望远镜的工作以及其他国际空间站系统的维修活动。

sentences.en: NASA noted it was the fourth spacewalk for Hague and the eighth for Williams.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局注意到这是海牙的第四个空间行走,威廉姆斯的第八个空间行走。

sentences.en: The space agency said Williams was preparing for another spacewalk planned for January 30.
sentences.zh: 空间局说威廉姆斯正在准备 另一条空间行走 计划于1月30日进行

sentences.en: Wilmore is expected to join Williams on that spacewalk, which NASA estimates will last about six-and-a-half hours.
sentences.zh: 威尔莫尔预计将加入威廉姆斯的太空漫步 NASA估计它会持续6个半小时

sentences.en: The two will be aiming to remove a radio antenna structure.
sentences.zh: 两者的目标是拆除无线电天线结构。

sentences.en: They will also be “searching for microbes” around the ISS for use in experiments.
sentences.zh: 它们还将在国际空间站周围“寻找微生物”,用于实验。

sentences.en: Here is a look at other experiments Wilmore and Williams have completed during their stay: New methods to grow food NASA said Wilmore and Williams have tested different methods for growing crops in space.
sentences.zh: 以下是Wilmore和Williams在逗留期间完成的其他实验:美国航天局说,Wilmore和Williams试验了在空间种植作物的不同方法。

sentences.en: Such methods could support humans who have longer stays in space in the future.
sentences.zh: 这种方法可以支持今后在空间停留时间较长的人。

sentences.en: One experiment is called the Plant Water Management investigation.
sentences.zh: 一个实验叫做植物水管理调查。

sentences.en: NASA said this experiment “uses the physical properties of fluids…to overcome the lack of gravity and provide hydration to plants.” The experiment aims to help NASA develop hydroponic systems to support future space missions.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局说,这一实验“利用液体的物理特性......来克服重力的缺乏和为植物提供水分。” 该实验旨在帮助美国航天局开发水栽培系统,以支持未来的空间飞行任务。

sentences.en: Another experiment examines a new way to grow vegetables, plants and flowers inside the ISS to provide nutrition and beauty.
sentences.zh: 另一项实验研究在国际空间站内种植蔬菜、植物和花卉的新方法,以提供营养和美。

sentences.en: As part of this experiment, Wilmore installed a new light meter inside the ISS.
sentences.zh: 作为这一实验的一部分,Wilmore在国际空间站内安装了新的光度计。

sentences.en: The device is designed to measure available light and to help crew members improve growing operations.
sentences.zh: 该装置旨在测量现有光线,帮助船员改进不断增长的作业。

sentences.en: Robot assistants NASA also said that throughout the current mission, Williams had deployed and observed three free-flying robots called Astrobee.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局的机器人助理还说,在当前整个任务期间,威廉姆斯部署并观察了三个自由飞行的机器人,即Astrobee。

sentences.en: This robotic experiment seeks to examine how such robots could assist astronauts with daily duties and maintenance work.
sentences.zh: 这一机器人实验旨在研究这类机器人如何协助宇航员履行日常职责和从事维修工作。

sentences.en: The agency said the square-shaped robots are designed to help scientists and engineers develop and test new robotic technologies for use in microgravity environments.
sentences.zh: 该机构说,方形机器人旨在帮助科学家和工程师开发和测试用于微重力环境的新机器人技术。

sentences.en: The assistants are also designed to help astronauts with daily tasks “and give ground controllers additional eyes and ears on the space station.”
sentences.zh: 助理人员还旨在帮助宇航员完成日常任务,“并在空间站上增加地面控制器的耳目。”

sentences.en: Williams tested the robots’ ability to map the inside of the space station and Astrobee’s flight abilities.
sentences.zh: Williams测试了机器人在空间站内部绘制地图的能力和星盘的飞行能力。

sentences.en: Image captures from space NASA astronauts visiting the ISS have a long history of capturing images of Earth from space.
sentences.zh: 访问国际空间站的美国航天局宇航员从空间拍摄地球图像的历史悠久。

sentences.en: And this is another activity Wilmore and Williams have carried out.
sentences.zh: 这是Wilmore和Williams的另一项活动。

sentences.en: The ISS gives astronauts a “window to the world” as they orbit 400 kilometers above their home planet.
sentences.zh: 空间站为宇航员提供了一个“世界之窗”,因为宇航员的轨道在其本国地球上空400公里。

sentences.en: During their mission, NASA said the two astronauts had “captured hundreds of photographs of Earth, ranging from auroras , land, sea, orbital sunrises and sunsets, and more.”
sentences.zh: 美国航天局在执行任务时说,这两名宇航员“拍摄了数百张地球照片,包括极光、陆地、海洋、轨道日出和日落等等。”

sentences.en: Radio connections with Earth Another space station tradition is for U.S. astronauts to connect with students and other interested individuals during their stay in space.
sentences.zh: 另一个空间站传统是美国航天员在学生和其他有关个人停留在空间期间与他们建立联系。

sentences.en: They have virtual visits with people back on Earth who can ask the astronauts how it feels to live in space and can learn about NASA’s experiments aboard the ISS.
sentences.zh: 他们有虚拟访问 与人回到地球 谁可以问宇航员 感觉如何 在空间生活 并可以了解 美国航天局的实验 在空间站上。

sentences.en: In early August, Williams used ham radio technology to connect with students from Banda Aceh, Indonesia.
sentences.zh: 8月初,Williams使用火腿无线电技术与印度尼西亚班达亚齐的学生连接。

sentences.en: NASA explained that students get the chance to communicate with the astronauts when the ISS passes overhead.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局解释说,当国际空间站通过上空时,学生有机会与宇航员沟通。

sentences.en: The students can ask about research on the ISS as well as the radio wave technology that makes the communication possible.
sentences.zh: 学生们可以询问关于国际空间站的研究以及使通信成为可能的无线电波技术。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from NASA and The Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩·林恩。布莱恩·林恩根据美国航天局和美联社的报告,为VOA学习英语撰写了这个故事。
